description: Load layers' transparency as the selection, as Cmd/Ctrl-clicking a layer thumbnail does: replace, add to, subtract from or intersect with the current selection. With several layers, replace selects all of their pixels together

combine.description: How it combines with the current selection. Default replace

target.description: Which layers to act on. Give ids (from list_layers or a create tool), names, or active: true

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

name: select_layer_pixels
title: Select Layer Pixels
